name: 缺失机制分类

evidence_inputs: source health status and authorization status
source/API failure events and HTTP status
cloud mask, cloud probability, SCL and Q34
declared cadence, expected interval and observed series gaps
implementation.policy_separation: Each mechanism returns a distinct downstream policy; no generic imputer is applied to all missing rows.

actual_controlled_run.interpretation: The controlled normalized batch contains no null clean values; mechanism-specific missingness is demonstrated by offline unit tests and remains available for future authorized water-station/remote batches.

acceptance: 接口失败、设备离线、低频正常、云遮挡和质量拒绝可分别识别
短缺口、长缺口和边缘缺口具有独立机制和策略
短缺口插补只对 temporal_gap_short 候选开放，其他机制进入 pending 或保持缺失
实际快照数据没有被伪造为实时缺失记录
